Zero norm products or zero variance coefficients are outside the respective proportional prescriptions as stated here and require separate treatment; no zero-shot estimator is defined. The retained audit checks positive variance coefficients in its conditional arrays and does not supply a policy for the zero-coefficient case. Integer allocations constrained to positive shot counts require a separate constrained prescription: no rounding or minimum-shot allocation rule is asserted here.
